source_attempts.detail: no ETHERSCAN_API_KEY / BASESCAN_API_KEY in the environment

hooks.why: no provider holds a verified source for this address (sourcify=NOT_FOUND; etherscan=UNAVAILABLE)

hooks.taken_where: beforeSwap — returns a fee with `OVERRIDE_FEE_FLAG`, so the PoolManager charges the hook's number as the LP fee for that swap
hooks.announced: yes — a named constant with a NatSpec comment saying 1 %, and the decay window is documented in the same file
hooks.modifiable: no — `LP_FEE_V4` is `constant`, fixed in the deployed bytecode; only a redeploy through the upgrade gate can change it

citations.claim: the steady-state fee is a constant equal to 10 000 pips = 1 % = 100 bps
beforeSwap returns that fee with the override flag
the override flag makes the pool charge it instead of its stored LP fee
for the first 10 seconds of a coin's life the fee starts at 99 % and decays
the decay window is 10 seconds
trend coins settle at 100 pips = 1 bps instead
the hook itself returns no swap delta — it collects LP fees from its own positions

the total decays from an anti-snipe surcharge down to the base fee
the admin-settable base fee is capped at 10 %
the total per-swap fee is capped strictly below 100 %
a pool's config can never be rewritten
every swap emits the fee actually taken

hooks.taken_where: beforeSwap when the quote currency is the specified side (a BeforeSwapDelta on the input, minted to a FeeEscrow), otherwise afterSwap on the output
hooks.announced: yes — the whole per-pool config is a public mapping, a `PoolRegistered` event carries the fee, every swap emits `Trade` with the amount, and two public constants cap it
hooks.modifiable: no — `registerPool` reverts with `AlreadyRegistered` if the pool already has a config, and there is no setter; the config is frozen at launch

citations.claim: the fee is per-pool state, not a constant
and the whole config is publicly readable
an unregistered pool is charged nothing — first line of beforeSwap
the fee is taken in beforeSwap by minting a claim to the escrow
and returned as a BeforeSwapDelta on the specified side
otherwise it is taken in afterSwap out of the unspecified side
the total decays from an anti-snipe surcharge down to the base fee
the admin-settable base fee is capped at 10 %
the total per-swap fee is capped strictly below 100 %
a pool's config can never be rewritten
every swap emits the fee actually taken
citations.text: emit Trade(id, sender, validReferrer ? referrer : address(0), currencyAddr, totalFee, comment);

hooks.taken_where: beforeSwap (BeforeSwapDelta on the input) or afterSwap (delta on the output), plus the pool's LP fee set for the swap
hooks.announced: yes — per-pool `clankerFee` / `pairedFee` are public mappings, emitted in `PoolInitialized`, and capped by a public constant
hooks.modifiable: the per-pool fees are written once at pool initialization by the factory; the protocol-fee share is a public constant in the bytecode

citations.claim: the per-swap LP fee is a per-pool stored value, chosen by direction
that value is also pushed into the pool as a dynamic LP fee
the hook's own cut is 20 % of that LP fee
citations.text: uint256 public constant PROTOCOL_FEE_NUMERATOR = 200_000; // 20% of the imposed LP fee

citations.claim: and is computed from it, not configured separately
buying the token, the cut is taken in beforeSwap by shrinking the input
selling the token, it is taken in afterSwap out of the output
the per-pool fees are public and readable by anyone
they are announced in an event at pool creation
and hard-capped at 10 % by a public constant
citations.text: uint24 public constant MAX_LP_FEE = 100_000; // LP fee capped at 10%

citations.claim: a MEV module may raise the fee for the first swaps of a pool's life
citations.text: uint24 public constant MAX_MEV_LP_FEE = 800_000; // Max MEV LP fee at 80%

citations.claim: one deployment in this corpus is a fork where the 20 % carve is a per-deployment immutable instead of a constant

citations.claim: the fee is per-pool state, not a constant

otherwise it is taken in afterSwap out of the unspecified side
the total decays from an anti-snipe surcharge down to the base fee
the admin-settable base fee is capped at 10 %
the total per-swap fee is capped strictly below 100 %
a pool's config can never be rewritten
every swap emits the fee actually taken
